Text: $CAT The FTC and USDA just opened a joint inquiry into anticompetitive practices across agricultural equipment (WSJ). Farmers told the USDA they face barriers buying equipment and the service to keep it running. The targets read like the Dow industrial shelf: Caterpillar off nearly 6 percent Wednesday, CNH and AGCO off more than 5, Deere down about 3. What it touches is the dealer-service line, the recurring revenue stream these companies run on. And the tape irony: CAT was the Dow's hero Tuesday, its biggest drag today. Author: cermakpool
Text: $CAT A caterpillar is the larval stage (the second stage) in the complete metamorphosis of a butterfly or moth. The four stages of this life cycle are: • Stage 1 (Egg): Laid by an adult female on a host plant. • Stage 2 (Larva / Caterpillar): The feeding and growing stage. The caterpillar eats constantly, molts (sheds its skin) multiple times across phases called instars, and increases significantly in size. • Stage 3 (Pupa / Chrysalis): The resting and transformation stage where the caterpillar's body reorganizes into a winged adult. • Stage 4 (Adult): The winged butterfly or moth whose primary focus is mating and laying eggs
